name: Emmara Tandris
description: Emmara Tandris is an elf and high-ranking priest of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, its champion and repeated acting guildmaster, and a close friend of Jace Beleren.

description_citations.text: "Emmara Tandris". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Emmara Tandris (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Emmara Tandris is an elf and high-ranking priest of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, its champion and repeated acting guildmaster, and a close friend of Jace Beleren.

citations.text: "Emmara Tandris". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Emmara Tandris (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Emmara survived the Guildpact's dissolution riots as a healer and later befriended and aided Jace, and was gravely wounded by Mirko Vosk.

citations.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Implicit Maze she exposed Lazav, who had replaced Captain Calomir, and held off Exava's demons at the Rakdos guildgate.

citations.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the Supreme Verdict she asked Jace to erase her memory of other worlds and planeswalkers, and he did.

bio.text: She was chosen as Selesnya's champion, and stepped forward to lead the Conclave when Trostani's three heads fell into discord.

status.text: Emmara is alive and leads the Selesnya Conclave in Trostani's absence, speaking for it as of Karlov Manor.

citations.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact's dissolution riots, Emmara survives as a healer in Ovitzia and befriends the young telepath Berrim.
timeline.quote: she met a young telepath named Berrim

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Berrim asks about the Infinite Consortium and Emmara warns him, but he ignores her.
timeline.quote: she knew that he'd ignored her warnings

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Years later Emmara heals the tortured Berrim, then Jace arrives bleeding with Liliana Vess; Tezzeret's assassin interrupts and Jace decides to attack Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Emmara healed him and once again urged him to leave

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani commands Emmara to investigate the Izzet and gives her command of the conclave's elementals; she forgives Jace, but House Dimir has followed her.
timeline.quote: House Dimir had already followed Emmara, and she had led them right to Jace.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace erases his memory of the Izzet's secrets as Emmara watches helpless, and the Rakdos come for them.
timeline.quote: she was left helpless as she watched him destroy his knowledge

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara goes willingly with the Rakdos, escapes to the Golgari sewers, and saves Jace from Varolz, but the Dimir strike.
timeline.quote: Using her power over elementals, she saved her friend

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirko Vosk gravely wounds Emmara; at Vitu-Ghazi Jace meets Captain Calomir, cannot read him and is thrown out of Conclave territory.
timeline.quote: he was quickly thrown from Conclave territory

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Calomir overrides Emmara's fears and Trostani calls for war; Emmara agrees to summon the greater elementals.
timeline.quote: she agreed to summon the greater elementals of the Selesnyan Conclave

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Selesnya march on the Rakdos and into the Boros Legion; Niv-Mizzet reveals the maze's secrets, Emmara is arrested for treason and learns from Jace that Lazav replaced Calomir.
timeline.quote: she learned that Lazav had taken Calomir's place months ago

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara exposes Lazav but sows dissent; she runs the maze with Jace until Ral Zarek makes Jace reveal his lies at the Izzet Guildgate.
timeline.quote: she lured Lazav and managed to expose him

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Rakdos guildgate Emmara withstands Exava's demons until Trostani arrives with reinforcements.
timeline.quote: Trostani arrived with reinforcements, apologetic for the trials Emmara had suffered

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Forum of Azor Lazav influences the runners, but Jace's telepathy stops the Maze, triggering the Supreme Verdict that makes him Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: This triggered the Supreme Verdict , which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara asks Jace to erase her memory of the other worlds and who he was, and he agrees.
timeline.quote: She asked him to erase that memory from her mind, and sadly, Jace acquiesced.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek forces Jace to reveal he is a planeswalker to Emmara.
timeline.quote: Ral forced Jace to reveal his identity to Emmara

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At her request Jace erases Emmara's memories of other worlds and planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Regretfully, Jace granted her request.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris was chosen as Selesnya's champion.
timeline.quote: When Selesnya needed a champion, Emmara put the ranks of her guild before herself

citation.text: Emmara Tandris (Dragon's Maze, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lavinia is chosen to run the maze for the Azorius and arrests Jace at the Azorius Guildgate.
timeline.quote: Lavinia took the opportunity to, at last, arrest Jace

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: During the Implicit Maze, a battle erupts in Rix Maadi between Rakdos and Selesnya, wounding Exava and Emmara.
timeline.quote: a battle broke out between the local Rakdos and Selesnya representatives

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Trostani is divided and Garo is revealed as Bolas's ally, Emmara steps forward to lead the Conclave and pursue guild peace.
timeline.quote: Emmara stepped forward to fill the void in leadership

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara attends the guild summit for the Conclave and witnesses its dissolution after Isperia's murder.
timeline.quote: witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara first declines Kaya's plan to revive Niv-Mizzet, but Harmony wakes and the Selesnya join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara represents the Selesnya at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection; three years later she regains control of the guild when Trostani is implicated in the Karlov Manor murders.
timeline.quote: Tandris regained control of the guild

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Before the War of the Spark Trostani's three heads fall into discord, and Emmara steps forward after Garo is revealed to be in league with Bolas.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership, after glade-master Garo was revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat ask Selesnya's help to revive Niv-Mizzet; Emmara declines but Harmony wakes and commits Selesnya to the alliance against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Before the War of the Spark the three heads of Trostani are in discord, leaving her paralyzed; Emmara Tandris fills the leadership void.
timeline.quote: During the War, Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Emmara the plan is called Operation Desperation and argues Bolas must be defeated.
timeline.quote: Operation Desperation.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Trostani commits a series of murders of prominent Ravnicans with mind-controlling spores; Oba is subdued by her sisters and control returns to Emmara.
timeline.quote: After Oba was subdued by her sisters, Trostani stepped back to confer with Mat'Selesnya, returning control of the guild to Emmara Tandris.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave while we are in communion

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba's sisters enter meditation, leaving Emmara Tandris to lead; Kaya regrets not killing Oba and Teysa's ghost promises a punishing lawsuit.
timeline.quote: leaving Emmara Tandris to lead the guild.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Storm spells by Izzet mages darken the skies as the maze runners converge on the Forum.
timeline.quote: as the maze runners converged on the Forum one by one

citation.text: "Supreme Verdict", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace honors Emmara Tandris's request to erase her knowledge of planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: honored Emmara Tandris’s request to erase her knowledge of planeswalkers

citation.text: "Supreme Verdict", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani withdraws, leaving Emmara Tandris in charge; Teysa leads the Orzhov as a ghost.
timeline.quote: Trostani withdrew from leadership, leaving Emmara Tandris in charge

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
